title: Cursor/h25 g12 identity cleanup 5d9d
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Partial source repair of two G12 custody defects. This is not a construction, not a paid-profile change, and not a κ improvement. Selected κ stays 781451/250000000. The five framework assumptions stay in force.

The frozen PR6321 parent emits manifest identity as an ordered six-tuple inside the accepted nine-tuple. The consumer file-record validator requires a string-keyed dictionary, so the raw tuple fails G12-N12. The corrected consumer converts that tuple at the boundary and rejects a dictionary, a bad length, a non-integer, a nonpositive inode, and a non-regular mode. The corrected parent names the packer and still emits the tuple.

Two parent preflight finally blocks used a bare os.close loop. A close error replaced the pending primary and skipped later descriptors. The successor closes every descriptor, keeps a pending primary, and fails when the body succeeded but a close failed.

## Task and overlap

Base: 626e936ce4d61f2584316914fc71baf96940c512 (priority revision 8; selected record is PR6030). Predecessor: PR6321 ca9d90e93dc495e1e5e5ef6d271ff1e4f089cd0c, blobs 80482f9a9af1f471bc567c52cc31e6dc8a39c26f and 19cb9376c2d757e1deb354608a1351c39e4daae1.

Card portable-replay, scope changed. The card starts from the gzip-container comparison. This package answers the open H25 cache handoff (discussion #1166 comment 19307764, task A) instead. Nearest overlap is PR6321 itself, which publishes the rejected sources and asks for this repair. It does not contain the repair.

## Validation

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-g12-identity-cleanup --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-g12-identity-cleanup
```

Python 3.12. Both normal and optimized commands print PASS_H25_G12_IDENTITY_CLEANUP. Checks cover predecessor hashes and blob ids, tuple rejection, conversion round-trip, primary-preserving closes, and a bare-finally control that still drops the primary. The H25 parent was not executed. The other 18 negative branches were not reviewed. No N22/P07 body credit and no measured gain.

## Credit

Chris R / Clear1nsight, PR6321 and PR6029, and the retained Douglas R. Colkitt circuit, network and verification lineage. Predecessor bytes are unchanged. Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Independently review the corrected parent-to-adapter-to-consumer path, including all 18 negative branches, before any N22/P07 credit.
2. Implement the accepted P02 v4 bridge from the same handoff, preserving producer order and both writer chains.
